body:
As noted in my edit, the crash is no longer happening for me. I _did_ just restart and update my computer after a long uptime, so that might've had something to do with it... 😅

However, it may still be good to figure out where the deadlock(?) is occurring and see if it's possible to prevent it from happening at all.

My current _guess_ is that at this part of `EditorExportPlatformAndroid::_check_for_changes_poll_thread()`, the `quit_request` is somehow getting unset or cleared before the thread's `while` loop has a chance to check it and exit out. As a result, execution stays stuck in here forever.

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/d51d1ec68204bfa91b0fd5499bf5eb7d79c88256/platform/android/export/export_plugin.cpp#L317

Again, though, just a guess. If/when I start getting this freeze again, I can try debugging this area in particular to see if that gets me any more insight.
